text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing.metering.token-drift detected for eu-west. Alert threshold breached (quiet-window delta). Please acknowledge if on-call.

sarah-oncall: ack — I'm on it, looking at shadow vs live emitters now. spinning up dashboards and logs.

raj-metering: I can join, seeing a rise in delta on shadow-ledger (consumer lag + duplicate keys). possible emitter retry loop.

sarah-oncall: quick check — are customers being charged yet?

mia-billing: not seeing actual charges posting to billing-runner, but overage flags/alerts fired for a handful of accounts (staging + a couple prod alert emails). pausing notification pipeline now.

tom-cs: received DM from customer acct_88 showing an overage email at 17:22 UTC. holding response pending ops update.

raj-metering: logs show emitter-v2 sent a replay on timeout, same request id twice. grep output:
```
$ kubectl -n metering logs deploy/emitter-v2 | grep "emit_token.*request_id"
emit_token request_id=abc123 status=ok
emit_token request_id=abc123 status=retry
```
This matches the shadow ledger duplicate keys.

sarah-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) flip shadow routing away from emitter-v2 to emitter-v1 to stop new duplicate inflight, 2) pause notification/overage emails (mia), 3) enable dedupe patch on consumer. executing step 1 now.

sarah-oncall: running feature flag toggle ->
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://ff.company/flags/shadow_routing -d '{"value":"emitter-v1"}'
```

raj-metering: confirming reroute — shadow traffic now hitting emitter-v1 (no duplicates in last 30s). still replay backlog being processed by consumer, working on dedupe patch and a controlled replay throttle.

mia-billing: notification pipeline paused, suppressing outbound overage emails and alert digests. I'll queue a customer hold message: "We detected an internal metering inconsistency and are holding notifications — no customer charges are being processed while we investigate."

tom-cs: thanks — please DM me the affected account ids for outreach.

mia-billing: affected: acct_88, acct_197, acct_302 (small spike users). sending to tom now.

raj-metering: deploying consumer dedupe fix (small patch) to canary tomorrow, but I'll roll a hotfix to the consumer group for immediate dedupe on request_id. patch command: `kubectl -n metering rollout restart deploy/consumer-group --image=consumer:dedupe-hotfix`.

sarah-oncall: handing over to @raj-metering for next-steps and postmortem. I'll remain available for escalation (on-call until 18:30 UTC).

raj-metering: taking it. current status: reroute done, notifications paused, consumer hotfix rolling. monitoring token delta and shadow vs live reconciliation. will update in 15m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update: severity lowered to P2 — degradation contained, customer-facing notifications suppressed. Continue monitoring; on-call handoff to raj-metering at 18:30 UTC.
